p ≤.05), schema (F(1, 325), p ≤.01), and mental model (F(1, 325) = 6.70, p ≤.01) manipulations. It was found that the most
elegant leadership plans were obtained when people were presented with fewer (M = 2.95, SE = .062) as opposed to many
(M = 2.75, SE = .064) cases, when people were presented with fewer (M = 3.03, SE = .064) as opposed to many (M = 2.68,
SE = .063) schema, and when people were presented with simple (M = 2.97, SE = .063) as opposed to complex (M = 2.74,
SE = .063) mental models thus providing additional support for Hypotheses 1, 2, and 3. This simpliﬁcation of information and mental
models apparently contributes to the production of more elegant plans.
